display_name: LoRa R17 与物理残差实增益融合、冻结 E104 源域指导
description: 首轮 source V 筛查未通过后，固定新候选：R17 和 R07 伴随残差双方向频率实增益，源域真实标签及冻结 E104 高置信 U 伪标签训练，独立物理 V 子集筛查。
authorization: 当前聊天 01a2204f-647a-7903-ba29-81cfe8f8749b 的融合研发目标及 N607 有显存即启动要求。

code.environment: N607 CVS-RFFI PyTorch CUDA FP32 TF32off, independent CPU scorer

data.representation: 8192 complex points in 8 x 1024 chirps; frozen W24 E104/default head
data.physical_ids_ref: V RX b200_1: deterministic seed 2026112863 select 300 IDs excluding the prior 60 joint.panel IDs
data.label_map_ref: TX31-40 mapped 0-9; L_s labels only in training, U_s true TX hidden; source V truth only in independent scorer
target_receivers: 15 registered held-out LoRa RX remain unopened by this run
data.validation_ref: Existing VALIDATED_ONCE source contract and physical ID ordering
data.leo_config_ref: Registered source Full clean and practical_low_urban views

permissions.claim_scope: LoRa L_s true CE and frozen E104 clean U_s pseudo CE >=0.95 explicitly allowed by same-contract native E104 predecessor. U_s true TX hidden; V and target excluded from updates. V truth read separately only after clean and low-urban predictions freeze.

checkpoint.initialization: New two-direction real-gain head zero initialized; same-contract phase-aware realgain and raw R02/R07/R17 frozen.

sources.role: frozen same-contract LoRa realgain prior; inherited E104 supervised and U pseudo-label history
same-contract R02/R07 context and R17 three-prior unrolled reference
frozen E104 source teacher and original default head, source-V selected E104

checkpoint.contract_check_ref: Prior frozen checkpoints and same lora_rx5_main_v1:392005 role/receiver/ten-class identities; strict loads
checkpoint.provenance_verdict: No cross-dataset checkpoint. LoRa source-only pretarget fixed weights; historic target results have been exposed and source V used by E104 selection.
checkpoint.selection_rule: Final 4000-step checkpoint; low-urban net >=2 in each deterministic half of 300 against each of direct, native LoRa R17, and real gain; clean net >=-2 against each; report paired bootstrap intervals. This selected V subset excludes all 60 prior screening IDs.

execution.gpu_policy: One worker; first GPU with >=8192 MiB free in order 5,7,2,3,6,1,4,0; concurrent WiSig worker preserved.
execution.stop_rule: Stop on illegal input/weight/source role, nonfinite updates, missing actual E104-to-both-branches gradient in first real-checkpoint smoke, output collision, incomplete predictions or independent scorer failure. Preserve partial artifacts and other owners.

rows.method: Frozen phase-aware realgain plus two per-frequency real gains applied to R07 adjoint residual and R17-prior difference; frozen E104 supervision
rows.seed_notes: Selection seed +2 chooses RX-specific V IDs independent of labels; +3 assigns screen halves. No support.
rows.optimizer: AdamW weight_decay 1e-4, cosine 1e-4 to 1e-5, gradient clip 1
rows.budget_ref: 4000 updates, per update 4 L_s + 4 U_s; total 16000 L and 16000 U exposures; inherited training cost reported separately

notes: r02 first screen used 60 b200_1 source V packets; fixed new sample excludes these and draws 300 other V packets before any V truth read.
E104 selection historically used source V, and 15-receiver Full results have already been exposed; this screen is development evidence, not an independent target test.
Fixed DURA v1 has the WiSig 256-point source contract. The LoRa-native R17 is separately trained; the same-contract LoRa DURA v1 comparison remains outstanding before final acceptance.
Parameter count is a reported cost, not an optimization constraint. New model uses original R17 without compression.
Stop at screen rejection and preserve results; promotion alone does not establish final success. All seven views and independently scored matched controls remain required.
